summary: This revision satisfactorily resolves the substantive presentation and proof-interface requests in my v003 report. The core reduction-modulo-(1-omega) argument, its non-collinear pigeonhole step, the sharp constructions, and the stated corollaries remain intact; v004 adds the missing algebraic specialization proof, a precise valuation-domination route, and corrected language around numerical orbit searches. I found no material objection to the main claims.
weaknesses: The result is confined to prime dimensions, and the manuscript itself shows that the same statement fails in every composite dimension.
The broad priority claim is appropriately qualified, but priority was not exhaustively checked across all uncertainty-principle and finite-Heisenberg literature.
